description: Defines the RocketConditionalElement class, a custom UI element for conditional display based on console variables (cvars) and conditions, used within the Unvanquished game engine's UI system.

classes.name: RocketConditionalElement
classes.description: A UI element that conditionally displays its content based on cvar values and specified conditions.

methods.name: OnAttributeChange
methods.description: Handles changes to element attributes, updating internal state based on 'cvar', 'condition', and 'value' attributes.

methods.name: OnUpdate
methods.description: Updates the element's visibility based on the current cvar value and condition.

methods.name: ParseCondition
methods.description: Parses a string to set the condition type for comparison.

methods.name: IsConditionValid
methods.description: Evaluates whether the current cvar value satisfies the condition.

methods.name: ParseInt
methods.description: Converts a string to an integer, handling boolean and numeric conversions.
